verses.text: Ex xajanab'il wuuj, tzin tz'ib'ejb'at juntzanh tik t'ayex yik wach' maxtzak he k'ulej chukal. Palta tato ay b'aj tz'och ko mul, ay jun wan yak'anoch ko ti' t'a Dios, haton Jesucristo, te tojolnhej spensar.
Icha wal junok silab', icha chi' ix aj scham Cristo yuj stupanel ko mul. Manh yujoknhej ko mul a onh tik ix chami, palta yuj smul masanil anima ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yuj chi' ix chami.
Tato sko k'anab'ajej tas schekji ko b'eyb'alej yuj Dios, kojtakton Dios sik'lab'il syal chi'.
Tato skala' to kojtakxo Dios, palta max ko k'anab'ajej tas schekji ko b'eyb'alej yuj, esalwum onh syal chi', malaj jab'ok tas yel skala'.
Tato sko k'anab'ajej tas syal slolonel, t'a wal yel xajan ton Dios chi' kuuj sik'lab'il. Ichaton chi' tz'aj kojtakaneli to ayonh och t'ay.
Tato skal icha tik: Ha in tik ay in och t'a Cristo, tato xko chi, yowalil sko b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al Cristo chi'.

Ex xajanab'il wuuj, a jun cheknab'il swalb'at tik t'ayex, mantok hato tiknaik ol eyab'i. Yujto a jun cheknab'il tik, atax ix ex och yuninalok Dios ix alji t'ayex. Eyab'nakxo jun cheknab'il tik t'a peka' to yowalil sko xajanej ko b'a.

Palta swalxib'at jun cheknab'il tik t'ayex. Wan ko b'eyb'alan jun cheknab'il tik icha yutejnak sb'a Jesucristo, yujto a jun k'ik' k'inal ayoch t'ayonh, wan yek'kaneli, haxo jun sakil k'inal te yel wan yochkani.
Tato ay onh mach onh skala': Sakq'uinalxo yaj in pixan, tato xko chi, palta tato wan schichonpaxoch ko k'ool t'a junok ketkreyenteal, ay onhto och t'a k'ik' k'inal syal chi'.
Tato sko xajanej heb' ketkreyenteal, ayonhxo och t'a sakil k'inal syal chi'. Yuj chi' malaj junok tas ayoch t'ayonh tz'ik'an ko juwieli.

Palta a heb' hanheja' schichonoch sk'ool t'a heb' yetkreyenteal, k'ik'alq'uinalto yaj heb'. Icha wal junok mach sb'eyek' t'a k'ik' k'inal max yil-laj b'aj sb'ati, icha chi' heb', yujto juwinakel spensar heb'.
Tzin tz'ib'ejb'at juntzanh tik t'ayex a ex unin kreyente exto, yujto ha Dios ix ak'an lajwok he mul yuj Jesucristo.

Tzin tz'ib'ejb'at t'ayex a ex ayxo eyoch kreyenteal, yujto eyojtakxo Dios, jun aytaxon eq'ui atax manto b'o jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Tzin tz'ib'ejb'at jun tik t'ayex ex kreyente ayxo he tek'anil, yujto ix kan winh diablo t'a yalanh eyuuj wet'ok. Tzin tz'ib'ejxib'at jun tik t'ayex a ex unin kreyente exto, yujto eyojtakxo ko Mam Dios.

Tzin tz'ib'ejxib'at jun tik t'ayex ex ayxo eyoch kreyenteal, yujto eyojtakxo pax Dios, jun aytaxon eq'ui atax manto b'o jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha exxo kreyente ex ayxo he tek'anil, ix ex tek'k'aji, yujto chab'ilxo slolonel Dios eyuuj. Ix kan pax winh diablo t'a yalanh eyuuj wet'ok. Yuj chi' tzin tz'ib'ejb'at jun uum tik t'ayex.
Max yal ko xajanan jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik yet' pax juntzanh tas ay t'ay. Tato sko xajanej, manh wanok ko xajanan ko Mam Dios syal chi'.

Ha heb' anima ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, a juntzanh snib'ej sniwanil heb' snib'ejochi. Snib'anxioch juntzanh tas wach' yilji heb'. Say heb' yik niwan tz'aj yelk'ochi. Ha juntzanh b'eyb'al chi', manh yikok ko Mam Dios, a yol yib'anhk'inal tik ay yiko'.
Ha jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik yet' juntzanh snib'ejoch heb' anima chi' t'ay, ek'elb'anhej yaji. Palta tato sko k'ulej icha snib'ej Dios, pitzan onh t'a junelnhej yet'ok.

Ex xajanab'il wuuj, ay onh ek' t'a jun slajwub' tiempoal. Ix kab' heyet'ok to ay jun ayoch ajk'olal t'a Cristo ol pitzwok chaanh. Ilek nab'i, tzijtumxo heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay toxo ix pitzwi chaanh. Yuj chi' kojtak to ay onhxo ek' t'a slajwub' tiempoal tik.

Ha t'a ko kal ix elta heb' chi', yujto toxonton manh ketb'eyumok heb'. Q'uinalok tato ketb'eyum heb', ix am ajnhej heb' ket'ok, palta ix elta heb' yik wach' scheklajeli to toxonton manh ketb'eyumok heb'.
Ha Cristo ak'annakoch Yespíritu Dios t'ayex ket'ok, yuj chi' kojtak jun k'ayb'ub'al yel ko masanil.
Yuj chi' tzin tz'ib'ejb'at jun in karta tik t'ayex, manh yujok to manh eyojtakok jun k'ayb'ub'al yel chi' tzin tz'ib'anb'ati, palta yujto eyojtakxo. Eyojtakpaxi to malaj junok es ayoch t'ay.

Ol wal t'ayex machtak heb' tz'esani: Haton heb' tz'alani to a Jesús manh Cristooc, syalelk'ochi to manh ak'b'ilok yopisio yuj Dios. Haton heb' chi' ayoch ajk'olal t'a Cristo, yujto max scha yab' heb' to ha Dios ay Yuninal, yuj chi' aypaxoch heb' ajk'olal t'a Dios haton Mamab'il.
Ha heb' tz'alani to a Jesucristo manh Yuninalok Dios, manh ayokoch ko Mam Dios t'a heb'. Haxo pax heb' tz'alan jun to a Jesucristo Yuninal Dios, ayton och Dios t'a heb'.

Yuj chi', a jun k'ayb'ub'al ix kab'i atax yik ix onh och yikok Dios, yowalil skak'nhejoch t'a ko k'ool. Tato icha chi' skutej kak'anoch t'a ko k'ool, junxonhej ol onh aj yet' ko Mam Dios, junxonhej ol onh aj pax yet' Yuninal.
Yalnakkan Dios to ol yak' ko k 'inal t'a junelnhej.
Tik tzin tz'ib'ejb'at t'ayex yuj heb' snib'ej ex yak'an musansatil.

Ha Espíritu ak'b'il t'ayonh yuj Jesucristo, aynhejkanoch t'ayonh. Yuj chi' manh yowalilok ch'ok mach tzonh k'ayb'ani, yujto a Yespíritu chi' tzonh k'ayb'an t'a masanil tasi. Ha jun k'ayb'ub'al syak' t'ayonh chi' te yel, malaj jab'ok es ayoch t'a skal. Yuj chi', yowalil junxonhej tzonh aj yet' Cristo, yujto icha chi' tz'aj yalan Yespíritu t'ayonh.
Haxo tiknaik ex xajanab'il wuuj, yowalil junnhej tzonh aj yet' Cristo t'a masanil tiempo, yik wach' junk'olal tzonh aj t'a yichanh, manh ol onh q'uixwoklaj ayik ol jaxok.
Kojtak to a Jesucristo te tojol toni. Yuj chi' ichokab' tik tz'aj snachajel kuuj: Tato tojol skutej ko b'eyb'al, yuninal onh ton Dios syal chi'.
